podcast.body: A "boldly ballad" very much in the same vein as "Love Is Strange," but only reached number 85 on the Hot 100, performing worse than their previous record. Despite its lack of commercial success, it was a favorite of Buddy Holly, who recorded home demos of it. "Even though it was another boldly ballad, very much in the same vein as Lovey's Strange."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
